summary: @servicetitan/carto-charts-react preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js` via execFileSync. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated: setup.mjs uses obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming and string-lookup wrappers around its network/exec logic, and math_init.js is a single-line Bun-compiled bundle using a shuffled string-array cipher (function WV8StW rotating array n7gIxM) with hex-numeric identifiers. The package's stated purpose is a React chart host built on echarts-for-react, which has no functional need to fetch an alternate runtime and execute an obfuscated sibling bundle at install. Using a freshly downloaded alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated payload sidesteps Node-based install-time inspection and gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine on `npm install`. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` npm scope, which corresponds to a real company; the shape of the release is consistent with scope/account compromise rather than a legitimate vendor artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
